parole.testo: Borrowed from Old Turkic eski. Compare Turkish eski.
Possibly re-borrowed from Old Turkic [script needed] (Täzik, “non-Turk/Iranian of Central Asia”) after the Mongol Invasion (Orkhon inscription), from Middle Persian tʾcyk' (Tāčīk, Tāzīg, “Arab”).

parole.significato: Turk, someone of Turkic ethnicity (not necessarily from Turkey, e.g. Turkic peoples)
parole.testo: From Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (twlk' /⁠Turk⁠/), from Old Turkic 𐱅𐰇𐰼𐰜 (t²ẅr²ẅk²).
